purpose: Measure relative-position scaling and local actor sensitivities on existing observations before proposing another representation change.
procedure: For every reference state, differentiate the deterministic mean with respect to each input; multiply by that input's empirical standard deviation, then summarize group gradient norms.
limitations: One reused development world under an untrained reference trajectory, not each learned policy's state distribution.
Partial derivatives hold other observations fixed; they are not physically consistent interventions or causal importance scores.
Gradient magnitudes depend on the chosen state distribution and model; small sensitivity does not prove an input is useless or improperly scaled.
No simulator commands, training, model selection or performance comparison are performed.
All completed models from the two completed CPA seed pairs and both width arms are included; incomplete CPA seed 50600 is excluded until complete.
